newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: CRICKET-WILLIAMS HITS CENTURY AS WEST INDIES FORCE DRAW.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WILLIAMS HITS CENTURY AS WEST INDIES FORCE DRAW.

text.p: Opener Stuart Williams hit his maiden test century to help West Indies force a draw with India in the second test on Tuesday.
Williams scored 128 as West Indies, 140 behind on first innings, reached 299 for six in their second innings before rain ended the game one hour early on the fifth and final day.
The opening test in the five-match series was also drawn. The third test in Bridgetown, Barbados, starts on March 27.
West Indies, who made 296 all out in the first innings, had resumed on 118 for one, still 22 runs behind India, whose last test victory in the Caribbean was on the same ground 21 years ago.
Williams, having made 63 on Monday, reached three figures off 241 balls in 355 minutes, hitting one six and nine fours.
The opener, playing his 14th test, shared a record second wicket partnership for the ground against India of 176 with Shivnarine Chanderpaul, who made 79.
Chanderpaul fell in the second session when he tried to cut Sunil Joshi's left-arm spin and was caught by Mohammad Azharuddin at first slip.
Williams and Chanderpaul beat the previous second wicket best at Queen's Park Oval for West Indies against India of 119 between Easton McMorris and Rohan Kanhai in the 1961-62 series.

Brian Lara, who scored 14 in the first innings, made a subdued 19 before being surprised by the extra bounce of a delivery from leg spinner Anil Kumble, could not withdraw his bat, and was caught by Azharuddin at first slip.
Williams finally departed when he skied a drive off Joshi and was caught by Kumble at long on, having faced 299 balls in 452 minutes, hitting one six and 11 fours.
Kumble claimed his second wicket of the innings when he had Carl Hooper caught by Vangipurappu Laxman for 14 while Roland Holder was also caught by Laxman off Joshi for nine.
At the finish, Junior Murray was not out 12 and Curtly Ambrose not out 10.
Kumble took his wicket total to seven in the match and 15 in the series.
